summary: A monthly after-hours business mixer run by Steve Jencks' company Incredible Towns of WNC, held at 12 Bones Brewing in Arden. It is explicitly free, open to all, with no dues, fees, membership requirements, or exclusions, and is one of several interchangeable IBN formats (breakfast, lunch, dinner, evening social) rotating across WNC towns rather than a fixed-membership chapter with a returning core.

evidence.note: Listings describe it as a generic 'after-hours professional mixer' for promoting business and swapping referrals with 'WNC locals,' with no membership or sign-up language, and no leader or regular attendees named.

Site states IBN events (including Evening Social) are 'no cost to attend and open to all, with no attendance requirements, fees, dues or exclusions' and only optionally asks attendees to buy from the host venue.

Incredible Towns of WNC is run by Steve Jencks as a business/media company hosting many recurring commercial networking event series across WNC and other regions (Raleigh-Durham, Chattanooga, Knoxville), not a single community group.
Local news coverage frames IBN as a drop-in meetup format for 'Asheville business owners' broadly, not a fixed club with defined membership.
A public Facebook group exists for the overall IBN brand (shared across all its event formats), not one specific to the Evening Social.
